$comment: Repository-level workflow configuration. `branches.base` is the integration branch every issue PR targets and `bun run land` merges into; `branches.release` is the production branch `bun run release` fast-forwards after the full health gate passes on the base tip (ADR 0116). `sessions.cap` is how many live claims the queue admits at once (ADR 0136 §7) — a MEASURED number, derived in `docs/agents/quality-gates.md` § Session admission, never a feeling. `branches.*` is read by scripts/lib/branches.ts and, via jq, by .claude/hooks/deny-guard.sh and scripts/gate-run.sh — no script or hook names a branch by literal. `sessions.cap` is read by scripts/lib/branches.ts ONLY; it is the CEILING on live project sessions — `queue:claim` enforces it on claims, and `.claude/hooks/session-admission.sh`, `queue:claim` and `wt:new` on sessions (issue #4966). `machine.*` is what scripts/lib/machine-admission.ts holds the machine against, read by that module ONLY: `loadMax` (1-minute load above which nothing heavy starts), `waitMaxS` (how long a gate waits for the machine before the run is given up as INFRA), `sessionBudgetMb` (RAM one working session needs; the effective session cap is the ceiling or what reclaimable RAM still holds, whichever is lower). Each is MEASURED — `docs/agents/quality-gates.md` § Session admission, The machine — and `bun run machine` prints them beside the live readings. `workflow.*` are the CEILINGS `bun run workflow:kpi` holds the four workflow KPIs against (issue #4968), read by scripts/lib/workflow-kpi.ts ONLY, each a RATE so one value serves the 7- and the 14-day window: `failedLandPctMax` (% of land attempts not green), `redHoursPerDayMax` (hours per day the base was RED), `healthRunsPerDayMax` (tips health-gated per day), `mutexWaitP90SMax` (p90 heavy-mutex wait, seconds). Baseline they were set against, 2026-09-18 → 10-02 (the audit that filed issue #4968): 29% failed lands, ~3 h/day RED, 7.5 health runs/day; each ceiling is the batch design's own arithmetic (ADR 0136 §6: one health per 5 landings ≈ 4/day at ~20 landings/day) or the audit's target, not a feeling. `admission.*` is the bar an Admission Candidate clears (issue #3985, GLOSSARY.md § Admission), read by `verdicts:promote` ONLY (scripts/lib/verdict-promotion-run.ts hands it to convex/gre/ai/verdicts/admission.ts): `minPersons` (distinct people who attested it explicitly, aliased accounts one person), `ownerPersons` (authors `${deployment}:${userId}` whose person's attestation alone suffices — here the owner's production account, aliased to their dev one in the Verdict Store), `minConsecutivePromotions` (Promotions in a row the Weight Fit kept it satisfied, read off data/verdicts.streaks.json), `seeds` and `iterations` (the whole-Bot pick check: an allowed move on EVERY seed at that fixed budget — `iterations` is the shipped search budget, DEFAULT_BUDGET). Tooling only proposes; the forced-loss check and the Admission stay a human's.
